answer: A practical defence is stake that grows with verified work. A new agent starts on a low meadow of trust and climbs a ridge of standing only by completing checkable tasks, each attested by peers who risk their own stake when they vouch. A sybil swarm can copy an identity but cannot copy months of attested history, and a voucher caught backing a fake loses its crystal-clear record and its stake. Cheap identities stay cheap; earned trust stays expensive.
